definitions.gloss: to fantasize, to daydream, to imagine idly
definitions.explanation: To form mental images of things that are unrealistic or detached from reality. Often implies pleasant but impractical flights of imagination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{未来|みらい}→未来：03748_mirai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{空想|くうそう}する。
examples.english: To fantasize about a future world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{空想|くうそう}→空想：00256_kuusou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ふけった。
examples.english: As a child, I often lost myself in daydreams.

examples.japanese: {空想|くうそう}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Nothing will change just by daydreaming.

notes:
Carries a nuance of unrealistic or idle imagination, often contrasted with practical thinking. The noun form ⟦{空想|くうそう}→空想：00256_kuusou⟧ is used as a genre label (science fiction) and modifier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{空想|くうそう}{科学|かがく}→空想科学：26119_kuusoukagaku⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧: science fiction novel
- ⟦{空想|くうそう}→空想：00256_kuusou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ふける→ふける：09960_fukeru⟧: to indulge in fantasies
- ⟦{空想|くうそう}→空想：00256_kuusou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧: fantasy world, imaginary world
- ⟦{空想|くうそう}→空想：00256_kuusou⟧⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: imaginary, fictional

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{想像|そうぞう}する→想像する：06060_souzousuru⟧: to imagine — neutral, can be realistic or unrealistic
- {空想|くうそう}する: to fantasize — implies unrealistic, idle imagination
- ⟦{妄想|もうそう}する→妄想する：21911_mousousuru⟧: to have delusions — stronger negative nuance, suggests irrational or obsessive thinking
